id: 03_Lesson 1 How to Unbox and Test the MetalFab
title: 激光焊机与切割机：开箱、组装与调试（国内版）
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/03_Lesson 1 How to Unbox and Test the MetalFab.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/03_Lesson 1 How to Unbox and Test the MetalFab（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 这一课：两台设备一起装
points.K10: 装送丝机、送丝轮、送丝管

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台手持激光焊机和一台封闭式切割机中间，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between a wheeled handheld laser welder and a large enclosed laser cutting machine and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：焊机和切割机，从开箱到调试。
overlay: 激光焊机与切割机：开箱、组装与调试

shots.scene: 纸箱、木箱、扳手、电脑四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a cardboard box, a wooden crate, a wrench and a laptop. No people.
shots.narration: 开箱、组装、校准、试切。

shots.scene: 实验室门口停着一个大纸箱和一个大木箱，阿杰兴奋地搓手
shots.prompt_en: A large cardboard box and a huge wooden crate sit at the door of a university workshop; the young male student rubs his hands excitedly.
shots.narration: 实训室新到了两台激光设备。

shots.scene: 阿杰一个人想把木箱推进门，箱子歪了
shots.prompt_en: The young male student alone tries to push the huge crate through the door and it tilts dangerously.
shots.narration: 阿杰想一个人把木箱推进去。

shots.scene: 老李和王老师赶来扶住箱子
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the safety administrator rush over and steady the crate.
shots.narration: 老李赶紧扶住：大设备，得一起来。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 装得对、用得稳，安全才有保障。

shots.section_title: 这一课：两台设备一起装
shots.scene: 两台设备并排的示意图，一条线缆把焊接头连到切割机里
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a handheld laser welder and an enclosed cutting machine side by side, with the welding head cable running into the cutting machine. No people.
shots.narration: 焊机既能手持用，也能装进切割机。
overlay: 这一课：两台设备一起装

shots.section_title: 这一课：两台设备一起装
shots.scene: 两个空白章节卡：焊机、切割机
shots.prompt_en: Two blank chapter cards side by side, one with a welding gun icon and one with a cutting machine icon. No people.
shots.narration: 先装焊机，再装切割机。

shots.scene: 纸箱上的开箱示意图，老李掀开顶盖
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer looks at a simple unboxing diagram printed on the box, then lifts off the lid.
shots.narration: 看清箱上的提示，先开顶盖拆外箱。

shots.scene: 先取出焊接头，再拿掉泡沫
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts the welding head out of the foam first, then removes the foam blocks.
shots.narration: 先取焊接头，再拿泡沫。

shots.scene: 线缆被折成锐角的图标打叉，旁边圆弧弯打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a cable bent into a sharp kink crossed out with a red X, and a cable in a gentle curve with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 线缆不能急弯，会影响激光传输。

shots.scene: 线缆绕挂在主机侧面
shots.prompt_en: The long cable is wound in neat loops on the side hanger of the welder unit. No people.
shots.narration: 绕好挂在主机侧面。

shots.scene: 焊机正面示意：急停、钥匙孔、接口
shots.prompt_en: Front view diagram of the welder unit with a red emergency stop button, a key slot and several ports, all with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 正面有急停、钥匙孔和几个接口。

shots.scene: 焊机背面示意：电源开关、送丝机口、切割机口
shots.prompt_en: Rear view diagram of the welder unit with a power switch, a feeder port, a cutter port and a power port, all with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 背面有电源、送丝机和切割机接口。

shots.scene: 送丝机正背面示意
shots.prompt_en: Front and back view diagram of a small wire feeder with two buttons, a spool and a drive unit inside. No people.
shots.narration: 送丝机有按键、丝盘和送丝驱动。

shots.scene: 主机前后留空隙的示意，脚轮刹车踩下
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of the welder unit with clear space arrows in front and behind it, and a hand pressing a caster brake. No people besides the hand.
shots.narration: 前后留出间隙，锁住四个脚轮。

shots.scene: 蓝色气管一端插进主机，另一端接气瓶流量计，气瓶被链条固定
shots.prompt_en: A blue gas tube runs from the gas inlet on the welder to the flow meter of an upright gas cylinder chained to a wall bracket. No people.
shots.narration: 一端接主机，一端接气瓶或制气机。

shots.scene: 老李用内六角组装焊枪支架，焊接头放上去
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer assembles a black welding head cradle with a hex key and places the welding head on it.
shots.narration: 组装支架，焊接头放好。

shots.scene: 工件感应线插进主机接口
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a hand plugging the workpiece sensing cable into its port on the welder unit.
shots.narration: 工件感应线插进对应接口。

shots.scene: 电源线旁边的空白铭牌和三个图标
shots.prompt_en: A coiled power cable beside a blank rating plate and three icons: an AC plug, a dedicated circuit breaker and a ground symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 先看铭牌：独立回路，必须接地。

shots.scene: 老李戴绝缘手套在配电箱前接线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wearing insulated gloves wires a cable at a distribution box; a blank certificate badge hangs on his chest.
shots.narration: 硬接线，交给专业电工。

shots.scene: 圆形插头对准方向插入焊机并旋紧
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a round power connector aligned by an arrow and screwed into the socket on the welder.
shots.narration: 圆形插头对准方向，旋紧。

shots.scene: 手旋转红色急停按钮使其弹起，旁边旋转箭头
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a hand rotating a red emergency stop button so it pops up, with a curved arrow.
shots.narration: 旋转急停按钮，让它弹起来。

shots.scene: 插钥匙，打开电源开关，屏幕亮起
shots.prompt_en: A key is inserted into the key slot, then a finger flips the rocker power switch and the touchscreen lights up blank.
shots.narration: 插钥匙，开电源。

shots.scene: 小研用手机扫屏幕上的码，看培训视频
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student scans a square code pattern on the touchscreen with her phone and watches a video with a laser warning icon.
shots.narration: 首次开机，先看安全培训视频。

shots.scene: 电脑网页生成密码，屏幕出现开锁图标
shots.prompt_en: A laptop shows a blank web form with a key icon; the welder touchscreen shows an unlocked padlock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 看完生成密码，输入后解锁。

shots.scene: 屏幕设置页数值框，焊接头刻度管特写
shots.prompt_en: Split view: a blank value box on the touchscreen settings page and the graduated tube on the welding head. No people.
shots.narration: 对照焦距参考值，看刻度管。

shots.scene: 手松开卡扣推拉刻度管
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a hand opening a fastener and sliding the graduated tube on the welding head.
shots.narration: 不一致，就松卡扣推拉调整。

shots.section_title: 装送丝机、送丝轮、送丝管
shots.scene: 三个图标：焊接要送丝机，清洗和切割不要
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a weld seam with a wire feeder and a green check, a cleaning icon and a cutting icon each with the wire feeder crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 送丝机只在焊接时用。
overlay: 装送丝机、送丝轮、送丝管

shots.section_title: 装送丝机、送丝轮、送丝管
shots.scene: 送丝机放主机左侧，连接线两端一样
shots.prompt_en: The wire feeder stands on the left of the welder unit; a cable with identical round connectors on both ends links them. No people.
shots.narration: 放在主机左侧，用连接线接好。

shots.section_title: 装送丝机、送丝轮、送丝管
shots.scene: 送丝轮外侧规格放大，装到驱动上
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a drive roll with a magnified blank size marking being fitted onto the drive unit.
shots.narration: 送丝轮规格要和焊丝一致。

shots.section_title: 装送丝机、送丝轮、送丝管
shots.scene: 送丝管不带卡扣端插入送丝机
shots.prompt_en: Close view of hands inserting the plain end of the wire feeding tube into the wire feeder and tightening a screw.
shots.narration: 送丝管不带卡扣的一端插进去。

shots.scene: 一把钳子图标，旁边空白提示框
shots.prompt_en: A pair of pliers icon next to a blank tip card with an exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 装焊丝要自备钳子。

shots.scene: 丝盘孔对销钉装上，大丝盘旁套筒打叉
shots.prompt_en: A wire spool is fitted with its hole on the pin; beside it a large spool icon with the sleeve crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 丝盘孔对销钉；大丝盘不装套筒。

shots.scene: 捏紧丝头，戴手套剪掉弯头
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand pinches the loose wire end, then trims the bent end with pliers.
shots.narration: 捏紧丝头别松手，剪掉弯头。

shots.scene: 焊丝穿过送丝轮，合上压紧器，旁边空白张力表
shots.prompt_en: The wire passes between the drive rolls into the tube; tension levers close next to a blank table. No people.
shots.narration: 穿丝，合压紧器，按表调张力。

shots.scene: 按住送丝键，丝从焊接嘴伸出
shots.prompt_en: A finger holds the feed button on the wire feeder; the wire tip appears out of the welding nozzle groove. No people besides the hand.
shots.narration: 按住送丝键，丝出嘴就停。

shots.scene: 送丝管装到焊接头，放回支架
shots.prompt_en: The wire feeding tube is clipped onto the welding head tip, and the head is placed back on its cradle. No people.
shots.narration: 送丝管装到焊接头，放回支架。

shots.scene: 五个蓝色防护图标
shots.prompt_en: Five blue round safety pictograms: goggles, a welding face shield, a dust mask, gloves and coveralls. No people.
shots.narration: 开工前，防护用品一件不能少。

shots.scene: 防护面罩镜片特写，旁边波长图标
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a tinted face shield visor with a blank label and a small wavelength wave icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 面罩和眼镜，要对应激光波长。

shots.scene: 车间排风扇转动
shots.prompt_en: An exhaust fan in the workshop wall spins with airflow arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 工作间保持通风。

shots.scene: 流量计、出光关闭图标、开阀
shots.prompt_en: Three steps in a row: a flow meter on a chained cylinder, a laser toggle in the off position, and a gloved hand opening the cylinder valve. No people besides the hand.
shots.narration: 装流量计，确认出光关闭，开气。

shots.scene: 按握持键和扳机，流量计浮子升起
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand presses the grip button and trigger of the welding head while the float in the flow meter rises.
shots.narration: 按住握持键和扳机通气，调好流量。

shots.scene: 感应线夹在工件上打勾，夹在刻度管上打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a cable clamp on a metal workpiece with a green check, and a clamp on the welding head graduated tube with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 感应线夹工件，严禁夹刻度管。

shots.scene: 丝尖对准红点
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the welding wire tip meeting a small red aiming dot. No people.
shots.narration: 丝尖对准红光，偏了要校准。

shots.scene: 屏幕选材料、厚度、丝径，弹窗提醒戴防护
shots.prompt_en: A touchscreen with blank material, thickness and wire buttons, and a pop-up showing a face shield and goggles icon. No people.
shots.narration: 选参数，启用送丝和出光。

shots.scene: 阿杰全副防护在挡光帘后焊接
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in full protective gear with face shield welds two metal plates behind a laser safety curtain.
shots.narration: 先点焊两端，再焊整条缝。

shots.scene: 焊接头下压图标打叉，高温工件图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a welding head pressed down hard crossed out, and a glowing hot workpiece with a hot surface sign. No people.
shots.narration: 别往下压；焊完别空手碰。

shots.scene: 关机换清洗嘴，屏幕选清洗
shots.prompt_en: Hands swap the welding nozzle for a straight cleaning nozzle, then a finger taps a cleaning icon on the touchscreen.
shots.narration: 清洗：关机换嘴，开机选清洗。

shots.scene: 阿杰在挡光帘后平行焊缝清洗
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in full protective gear holds the welding head parallel to a weld seam and cleans it behind a laser safety curtain.
shots.narration: 焊接头平行焊缝清洗。

shots.scene: 记下参考值，关机换切割嘴
shots.prompt_en: A notepad with a blank value box, then hands fit a slim cutting tip onto the welding head.
shots.narration: 切割：记参考值，关机换切割嘴。

shots.scene: 气瓶换装带两块表的减压阀
shots.prompt_en: An upright chained gas cylinder fitted with a pressure-reducing regulator with two blank gauges. No people.
shots.narration: 换装带减压阀的压力表。

shots.scene: 红点清晰打勾，模糊打叉
shots.prompt_en: Split view: a sharp round red dot with a green check and a blurry broken dot with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 红光要清晰，不清晰先校准。

shots.scene: 阿杰在挡光帘后切割，火花溅向清空的地面
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in full protective gear cuts a metal plate behind a laser safety curtain; sparks fall onto a cleared metal floor area.
shots.narration: 气压按说明书调好，再切割。

shots.scene: 大小两个送丝嘴
shots.prompt_en: Two copper wire feeding nozzles, one small and one large, with blank tags. No people.
shots.narration: 送丝嘴按焊丝粗细来换。

shots.scene: 一个大木箱，四周画出至少一米的空地
shots.prompt_en: A large wooden crate on a pallet with floor marks showing a wide clear area around it on all sides. No people.
shots.narration: 切割机开箱前，四周留出足够空地。

shots.scene: 老李打开木箱前面的搭扣，前板放下成坡道
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens the metal latches on the front of the crate and lowers the front panel to form a ramp.
shots.narration: 先开前板搭扣，前板放下当坡道。

shots.scene: 再打开左右和后面的搭扣，拆掉侧板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the young male student open the latches on the left, right and rear panels and lift them away.
shots.narration: 再开左右后板，只留底板。

shots.scene: 配件盒里一排零件图标
shots.prompt_en: An open foam tray of parts with a blank checklist showing pictograms of nozzles, rings, screws and slats. No people.
shots.narration: 对照清单清点配件。

shots.scene: 剪开绑带，扳手旋起调平脚，离地约一厘米
shots.prompt_en: Hands cut a black strap, then use a wrench to raise a leveling foot so it sits a small gap above the limit block, shown with a measure mark.
shots.narration: 拆绑带，用扳手把调平脚旋起来。

shots.scene: 老李和阿杰一前一后扶着设备慢慢下坡道
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the young male student, wearing safety shoes and gloves, guide the heavy machine slowly down the wooden ramp, one in front and one behind.
shots.narration: 下坡会因惯性冲，要慢慢控速。

shots.scene: 设备就位，四周留出组装空间
shots.prompt_en: The machine stands in place with clear space arrows around all sides for assembly. No people.
shots.narration: 推到位置，四周留出组装空间。

shots.scene: 放下调平脚触地，扳手锁紧螺母
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a leveling foot lowered to the floor and a wrench tightening its nut.
shots.narration: 放下调平脚，锁紧螺母。

shots.scene: 内六角拆下底角固定杆，螺丝放进小盒
shots.prompt_en: Hands remove a fixing bar at the bottom corner with a hex key and put the screws into a small labelled-blank box.
shots.narration: 拆下底角固定杆，螺丝留好备用。

shots.scene: Z形扳手在机后摇升主机
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer turns a Z-shaped crank at the back of the machine; the main body rises on a scissor frame.
shots.narration: 用Z形扳手摇升主机。

shots.scene: 平视侧面白线与底梁平齐
shots.prompt_en: Close view at eye level of a white line on the side frame lining up with the base beam, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 平视白线，和底梁平齐就停。

shots.scene: 长固定杆对孔上螺丝，旁边提示先不拧紧
shots.prompt_en: Hands align a long fixing bar with holes on the frame and insert screws loosely; a small loose-screw icon floats beside.
shots.narration: 装长固定杆，螺丝先不拧紧。

shots.scene: 四根装完后用内六角全部拧紧
shots.prompt_en: After all four long bars are in place, a hand tightens every screw with a hex key.
shots.narration: 四根都装好，再全部拧紧。

shots.scene: 短固定杆装在前左右，箭头示意方向
shots.prompt_en: Short fixing bars are fitted on the front, left and right sides, with arrows showing their correct direction. No people.
shots.narration: 短固定杆注意安装方向。

shots.scene: 侧板凹槽对凸起推入，上螺丝
shots.prompt_en: Hands push a side panel so its grooves slide onto the frame protrusions, then fix it with two screws.
shots.narration: 侧板对槽推入，螺丝固定。

shots.scene: 前板和后板依次装上
shots.prompt_en: The front panel and then the back panel are pushed into place and secured with screws. No people besides hands.
shots.narration: 前板、后板依次装好。

shots.scene: 底板推入槽中
shots.prompt_en: A shallow metal base tray is slid into the slots at the bottom of the machine. No people.
shots.narration: 把底板推进卡槽。

shots.scene: 往底板里倒入沙子或水
shots.prompt_en: Hands pour sand into the base tray, and in a second view water is poured into it. No people besides hands.
shots.narration: 加适量沙或水，隔热防变形。

shots.scene: 排风扇箭头面朝上，接好插头
shots.prompt_en: An exhaust fan box with arrow marks facing up; a hand plugs its connector into the machine.
shots.narration: 排风扇箭头朝上，接好插头。

shots.scene: 排风扇对准四个销钉压到位
shots.prompt_en: The exhaust fan is aligned with four pins on the back of the machine and gently pressed into place.
shots.narration: 对准销钉，轻压到位。

shots.scene: 排烟软管用卡箍拧紧，另一端接到净化器
shots.prompt_en: A flexible smoke exhaust pipe is secured with hose clamps on the fan and connected to a white fume purifier box. No people besides hands.
shots.narration: 排烟管卡箍拧紧，接到净化器。

shots.scene: 天线拧到机背并竖起，挂钩用螺丝固定
shots.prompt_en: An external antenna is screwed onto the back of the machine and raised; a metal hook is fixed to the side with screws.
shots.narration: 装好天线和挂钩。

shots.scene: 通信线两端分别接到切割机和焊机并旋紧
shots.prompt_en: A communication cable is plugged into a port on the cutting machine and the other end into the control port on the welder, both screwed tight.
shots.narration: 通信线两头接好，旋紧。

shots.scene: 打开防护盖，取出三颗运输固定螺栓
shots.prompt_en: The lid of the cutting machine is opened and a hand removes three wing bolts used for transport fixing.
shots.narration: 开盖取出三颗运输固定螺栓。

shots.scene: 焊接头换上切割嘴
shots.prompt_en: Hands remove the welding tip from the handheld welding head and insert a cutting tip, aligning a small protrusion with a slot.
shots.narration: 焊接头换上切割嘴。

shots.scene: 示意：人握紧焊接头，把线缆拉直
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a person holding the welding head firmly while the cable from the welder is laid out straight. No people besides the outline figure.
shots.narration: 握紧焊接头，把线缆理直。

shots.scene: 焊接头对准滑架两个销钉，合上搭扣
shots.prompt_en: The welding head is aligned with two pins on the gantry carriage and a toggle latch is closed.
shots.narration: 对准销钉装上滑架，合上搭扣。

shots.scene: 线缆卡进线夹，远离导轨
shots.prompt_en: The cable is snapped into clamps along the gantry and kept clear of the guide rail, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 线缆卡好，不能碰到导轨。

shots.scene: 两台设备分别接电源
shots.prompt_en: Power cables are plugged into the cutting machine and the welder. No people.
shots.narration: 两台设备分别接电。

shots.scene: 两台设备的急停都旋起，插上钥匙
shots.prompt_en: Both red emergency stop buttons are rotated up, and a key is inserted into the welder.
shots.narration: 两台急停都要释放，插钥匙。

shots.scene: 取下防尘帽接气管，另一端接空压机和干燥机
shots.prompt_en: A dust cap is removed from the gas inlet and a tube is connected; the other end goes to an air compressor and an air dryer. No people.
shots.narration: 接气：气瓶，或空压机加干燥机。

shots.scene: 两台设备依次开机
shots.prompt_en: The welder power switch and then the cutting machine power switch are turned on. No people besides a finger.
shots.narration: 按说明开阀，两台依次开机。

shots.scene: 笔记本电脑上下载软件、连接设备
shots.prompt_en: A laptop shows a blank download page and a connect device window with a check icon. No people.
shots.narration: 下载设计软件，连接切割机。

shots.scene: 按下机器上的开始停止键，切割头自动运动
shots.prompt_en: A finger presses the glowing start-stop button on the machine; the cutting head moves by itself inside the closed lid.
shots.narration: 按开始键，机器自动做振动补偿。

shots.scene: 两台设备关机，取出焊接头
shots.prompt_en: Both machines are switched off and the welding head is taken out of the carriage.
shots.narration: 先关两台机，取出焊接头。

shots.scene: 拔出切割嘴，内六角松螺丝，U形件拉到刻度
shots.prompt_en: Close view of hands pulling out the cutting tip, loosening a screw with a small hex key and sliding a U-shaped part to a blank scale mark.
shots.narration: 按提示把U形件调到指定刻度。

shots.scene: 拧紧后拉一拉确认，装回滑架
shots.prompt_en: The screw is tightened, the part is tugged to check it is firm, and the welding head goes back onto the carriage.
shots.narration: 拧紧试牢，装回，理好线缆。

shots.scene: 对位贴纸贴在激光模块下，关盖
shots.prompt_en: A small alignment sticker is attached under the cutting tip, then the lid is closed.
shots.narration: 贴好对位贴纸，关上机盖。

shots.scene: 屏幕点单次出光；开盖看光斑是否在同心圆中心
shots.prompt_en: A laptop button for single emission is clicked; then a sticker with concentric circles shows a mark near the center. No people.
shots.narration: 单次出光，看光斑是否居中。

shots.scene: 印台给切割嘴上色，对位卡放在下面
shots.prompt_en: A red stamp pad is pressed against the cutting tip, then a small alignment card is placed right under it.
shots.narration: 不居中：印台上色，放对位卡。

shots.scene: 红印与红光对比，左右拧螺丝，前后点按钮
shots.prompt_en: Split view: a red ring mark on a card with a red dot offset, a small hex key turning a screw on the welding head, and forward-back buttons on a laptop. No people.
shots.narration: 左右拧螺丝，前后点按钮调。

shots.scene: 红点落在圆心，绿色对勾
shots.prompt_en: A red dot sits exactly in the center of a red ring mark, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 红点居中，校准完成。

shots.scene: 栅条齿朝上卡入槽，等距排列
shots.prompt_en: Metal slats with teeth facing up are placed in slots across the cutting bed at equal intervals. No people.
shots.narration: 栅条齿朝上，两端卡进槽。

shots.scene: 右夹具夹住板材右侧，拧紧
shots.prompt_en: A metal sheet is inserted into the right fixture and a knob is turned to tighten it.
shots.narration: 板材插进右夹具，拧紧。

shots.scene: 抬联动杆，左夹具右移夹住，拧紧放下
shots.prompt_en: A linkage lever is lifted, the left fixture slides right to hold the sheet, the knob is tightened and the lever lowered.
shots.narration: 左夹具移过来夹住，再拧紧。

shots.scene: 电脑上放图案、选材料和喷嘴
shots.prompt_en: On a laptop, a blank outline shape is placed on the material and material and nozzle icons are selected. No people.
shots.narration: 放图案，选材料和喷嘴。

shots.scene: 校准传感器，核对右侧检查清单
shots.prompt_en: A sensor calibration progress bar and a blank checklist with items being ticked on the laptop. No people.
shots.narration: 校准传感器，逐项核对要求。

shots.scene: 关盖按开始键，机内火花
shots.prompt_en: The lid is closed, a finger presses the start button, and sparks appear inside behind the tinted window.
shots.narration: 关盖，按开始键加工。

shots.scene: 戴耐热手套拉出底板，举起金属挂件
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing heat-resistant gloves pulls out the base tray and holds up a small metal animal-shaped ornament.
shots.narration: 戴耐热手套取件，第一件完成。

shots.scene: 王老师给学生发空白授权卡
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands blank authorization cards to the female graduate student and the young male student after training.
shots.narration: 培训考核、授权后才能操作。

shots.scene: 墙上空白操作规程，桌上预约本
shots.prompt_en: A blank operating procedure poster beside the machines and a blank booking logbook on a desk. No people.
shots.narration: 按规程操作，预约登记。

shots.scene: 大木箱旁四人分工，戴手套穿劳保鞋
shots.prompt_en: Four people in gloves and safety shoes stand around the big crate, each at a corner, ready to move it together.
shots.narration: 大设备搬运，多人配合分工。

shots.scene: 脚在机器轮下被压的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a foot under a heavy machine wheel, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 穿劳保鞋，脚别伸到设备下面。

shots.scene: 厂家工程师与老李一起安装
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer works together with a technician in uniform to assemble the machine frame.
shots.narration: 安装调试，最好由专业人员完成。

shots.scene: 封闭式切割机盖子关着，观察窗，机身激光警告标志
shots.prompt_en: The enclosed cutting machine with its lid closed, a tinted viewing window and a laser warning sign on the body. No people.
shots.narration: 切割机靠机罩挡住激光。

shots.scene: 开盖出光的图标打叉，联锁开关被短接打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: an open lid with a beam coming out crossed out, and a taped-over interlock switch crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 不开盖出光，不拆不短接联锁。

shots.scene: 手持焊接在挡光帘围起的受控区里，门上激光标志
shots.prompt_en: A welding booth enclosed by laser safety curtains with a laser warning sign on the closed door. No people.
shots.narration: 手持焊接，要在激光受控区里。

shots.scene: 受控区内人人戴防护眼镜
shots.prompt_en: Inside the laser area, everyone wears tinted laser safety goggles. The young male student and the facility engineer are shown.
shots.narration: 区里每个人都戴对应的防护镜。

shots.scene: 配电箱断路器拉下，挂上空白警示牌并上锁
shots.prompt_en: A circuit breaker in a distribution box is switched off, locked with a padlock and tagged with a blank warning tag. No people.
shots.narration: 接线前先断电、上锁、挂牌。

shots.scene: 老李用验电笔验电，戴绝缘手套
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wearing insulated gloves checks the terminals with a voltage tester.
shots.narration: 验明无电，持证电工才能接线。

shots.scene: 漏电保护开关和接地线特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a residual current circuit breaker and a green-yellow ground wire. No people.
shots.narration: 要有漏电保护，设备可靠接地。

shots.scene: 气瓶直立链条固定，远离设备
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder stands upright chained to a wall bracket, placed away from the machines. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶直立固定，远离火花热源。

shots.scene: 空压机软管接头和压力表
shots.prompt_en: Close view of an air compressor hose connector, an air dryer and a blank pressure gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 压缩空气管路要检查，不能超压。

shots.scene: 电脑上弹出黄色警告框，手指停在继续键上打叉
shots.prompt_en: A laptop shows a yellow warning pop-up with a gauge icon; a finger hovering over a continue button is crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 软件提示气压不足，别点继续。

shots.scene: 老李检查气源，问题解决后再加工
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the gas supply and hose; a green check appears on the laptop afterwards.
shots.narration: 先查明原因，处理好再加工。

shots.scene: 排风扇和净化器指示灯亮起，烟被抽走
shots.prompt_en: The exhaust fan on the machine runs and the fume purifier light is on; arrows show fumes leaving the cutting chamber. No people.
shots.narration: 加工时排风和净化器必须开。

shots.scene: 老李更换净化器滤芯
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer replaces a filter cartridge in the fume purifier.
shots.narration: 排烟管要密封，滤芯按时换。

shots.scene: 底板里的沙子接住发红的熔渣
shots.prompt_en: Glowing slag drops fall onto a layer of sand in the base tray and cool down. No people.
shots.narration: 底板的沙和水，也能接住高温熔渣。

shots.scene: 机旁灭火器，废料及时清理
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher hangs next to the machine; a hand empties scrap from the base tray into a metal bin.
shots.narration: 废料及时清，旁边备灭火器。

shots.scene: 关机拔钥匙，再把手伸进机内
shots.prompt_en: A hand switches off the power and removes the key before reaching into the machine to adjust the cutting tip.
shots.narration: 调校、换件前，关机拔钥匙。

shots.scene: 单次出光时盖子关着，人站在机外
shots.prompt_en: During a single emission test the lid is closed and the female graduate student stands outside the machine wearing laser safety glasses.
shots.narration: 需要出光的校准，一定关好盖。

shots.scene: 手拍下急停按钮
shots.prompt_en: A hand slaps the red emergency stop button on the cutting machine.
shots.narration: 异常冒烟、起火，立即按急停。

shots.scene: 阿杰捂眼，小研陪他去医院
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student accompanies the young male student, who covers one eye, toward a clinic sign with an eye icon.
shots.narration: 怀疑眼睛被照到，马上就医。

shots.scene: 撤离和打电话，三个报告图标
shots.prompt_en: Students leave by the exit sign while the female graduate student makes a phone call; icons of a lab door, a college building and a security shield appear.
shots.narration: 火情拨119，受伤拨120，逐级报告。

shots.scene: 关出光、关气、两台关机拔钥匙
shots.prompt_en: The laser toggle is switched off, the gas valve closed, both machines powered off and the key removed. No people besides hands.
shots.narration: 用完关出光、关气、关机拔钥匙。

shots.scene: 阿杰清理底板，在记录本上签字
shots.prompt_en: The young male student cleans the base tray and signs a blank equipment usage logbook.
shots.narration: 清理现场，填写使用记录。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现焊机、送丝机、气瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to floating icons of a welder unit, a wire feeder and a chained gas cylinder.
shots.narration: 焊机：接气、接电、装丝，先看培训。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现木箱、坡道、扳手图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to icons of a wooden crate, a ramp and a wrench.
shots.narration: 切割机：多人搬运，按顺序组装。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现三个校准图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to three icons: a vibration wave, a focus mark and a red dot in a circle.
shots.narration: 三项校准做完，再试切。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现机盖、排风、警告框图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to icons of a closed lid, an exhaust fan and a warning pop-up.
shots.narration: 关盖出光，排风开着，报警别忽略。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研、阿杰、老李、王老师在两台设备前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the female graduate student, the young male student, the facility engineer and the safety administrator wave goodbye in front of the two machines.
shots.narration: 装好用好，安全第一，下次见！
